title: Kossuth Lajos emigrációban (Lajos Kossuth in Exile)
grammar: Adverbial Participles, Rhetorical Imperatives & National Symbols Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who Kossuth was and what he did in exile.
I can say why Kossuth travelled to America, using azért, hogy.
I can say where Kossuth fled after Világos and what he proposed for the peoples of the Danube.
I can use six new words about Kossuth's exile, such as emigráció and körút.
